title: Astronomical Discoveries Hidden in Plain Sight!

scenes.text: Two Telescopes Reveal a Planet Overlooked for Years.

scenes.label: HIDDEN IN PLAIN SIGHT
scenes.text: The planet was hiding in the data of stars we already knew.

scenes.label: UNEXPECTED FINDING
scenes.text: It orbits a star similar to our Sun but was undetected until now.

scenes.label: A NEW PERSPECTIVE
scenes.text: This discovery encourages astronomers to revisit old data for more clues.
Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: A groundbreaking discovery of a planet hiding in plain sight has been made using existing data. Follow for daily science!
